'''Roan Lands''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the partner of the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]]. They founded the business [[Olin and Lands]], and started the resistance group [[The Eleven]] to oppose the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Olin's former rival, the Jedi-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith-Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], killed Lands to provoke Olin.

==Biography==
Roan Lands was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who met [[Ferus Olin]] shortly after Olin left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. They soon became partners as well as friends. Lands sold all of his possessions to finance the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] idea for a business, [[Olin and Lands]], in which the two of them would protect people who exposed corruption and dishonesty in various big businesses.<ref name="Book1" /> On one occasion that Olin would later remember as the best [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of his life, they visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tati]] and swam together in a waterfall-fed natural pool.<ref name="Book4">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>

Shortly following the institution of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Lands and Olin started a resistance group called [[The Eleven]]. Knowing the consequences of rebellion, the partners made a pact not to find each other should one of them be captured or imprisoned. Along with the Eleven, they started a massive uprising on Bellassa following the Imperial ousting of the Bellassan monarch. However, they were no match for the power of the Empire, and most of them were either killed or jailed. While Olin managed to escape, Lands was put into an Imperial detention facility on Bellassa and tortured heavily with a series of numerous neurotoxins.<ref name="Book1" />

During his search to find Olin, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] encountered Lands who was numbed to the point of near death by the neurotoxins. [[Amie Antin]], a doctor and newly-joined member of the Eleven, tried her best to cure Lands using [[spectacillin]] to cure the apparent infection and [[gas binder]]s to rid his blood of the leftover toxins, but nothing worked. Kenobi infiltrated the [[Imperial Garrisons|Imperial Garrison]] to find out what toxins had been used on Lands and discovered that it was a mixture of neurotoxins consisting of [[Loquasin]] and [[Titroxinate]], then [[Skirtopanol/Legends|Skirtopanol]] on the final day, listed for use under "Persuasion Techniques." After he was cured, Lands gave Kenobi clues as to where to find Olin.<ref name="Book1" />

Sometime later, free from the Imperials, Lands reunited with Olin at the [[Nixor Spaceport]] and provided him with prefab shelters, food, and supplies to start an [[Jedi asteroid|asteroid sanctuary]] for the survivors of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="Book2">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>

Lands later went back to Bellassa and was arrested along with [[Dona Telamark]] by the Empire on charges of conspiracy against the government of Bellassa and plotting to assassinate the Bellassan Imperial [[Advisor/Legends|Advisor]]. The two prisoners were held aboard the ''[[True Justice]]'', a ship owned by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]], to coerce Olin into working for the Empire. Scheduled for a speedy trial by Judge [[Bellican]], Attorney [[Oryon|Tomay Alcorn]], and law clerk [[Sam Weller]], the duo was unexpectedly set free when [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]], Oryon, and [[Trever Flume]], impersonating the Imperial judicial team, hijacked the retrofitted [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="Tangled Web">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref>

After providing assistance to the residents of the asteroid base,<ref name="Return of the Dark Side">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Return of the Dark Side]]''</ref> Lands returned to Bellassa and the Eleven to continue resisting the Empire while Olin remained inside as a double agent. However, when the Empire publicized Olin's collaboration with the Imperial takeover, the whole city of Ussa was demoralized. The Eleven knew that Olin was a double agent, but many Bellassans did not, so Lands used a signal to communicate to Olin to meet him. Olin told Lands that the Eleven could have fifteen minutes to hit an Imperial factory for information. The three-person team was decided to be Lands, Flume, and [[Amie Antin]]. Everything went as planned until they stumbled across [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself. Olin arrived shortly, but Vader struck down Lands to provoke Olin. With his last breath, Olin and Lands shared their own private farewell.<ref name="Secret Weapon">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref>

Following the Battle of Yavin, Lands' memory served as a final comfort to Olin during the latter's final moments on the moon of [[Samaria/Legends|Samaria]]. While attempting to secure the escape of Princess Leia Organa and a group of Rebel prisoners, Olin engaged [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in a fatal lightsaber duel. As Olin lay mortally wounded in Organa's arms, his consciousness saw the spirit of Lands appear before him. In this final transition into death, the spiritual presence of Lands reached out and held Olin's hand, symbolically reuniting the two former partners years after Lands' tragic execution on Bellassa.<ref name="Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Jude Watson]], who created Roan Lands and Ferus Olin, addressed via [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that she envisioned the pair as mutually in love and married.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|judymblundell|status/647169127363268609|[[Jude Watson]]|quote=@LelalMekha @antinezushi In my mind Ferus and Roan were married. So yes, mutual! #starwars #lastofthejedi|archivedate=20210323052450}}</ref>
